context_requirements: Expression of GPR35 or GPR55 in the assayed cell line
Presence of a constitutively active or ligand-driven Gq/Gi pathway coupled to the receptor
A transcriptional output linked to the receptor's signaling pathway
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines that is absent in vehicle controls
Changes in known GPCR signaling target genes such as FOS, JUN, EGR1, or NFKBIA
